description: This file defines a set of functions and a wrapper for an agent tool related to editing text files, including path resolution, change detection, and error recovery mechanisms.

methods.name: resolveEditPath
methods.description: Resolves a file path, expanding '~' to home directory and resolving relative paths against a root.

methods.name: readStringParam
methods.description: Reads a string parameter from a record object using multiple possible keys.

methods.name: readEditReplacements
methods.description: Extracts an array of EditReplacement objects from a record, filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: readEditToolParams
methods.description: Normalizes input parameters into an EditToolParams object.

methods.name: normalizeToLF
methods.description: Converts Windows-style line endings to Unix-style.

methods.name: removeExactOccurrences
methods.description: Removes all exact occurrences of a substring from content.

methods.name: didEditLikelyApply
methods.description: Determines if the edits likely resulted in the current content based on heuristics.

methods.name: buildEditSuccessResult
methods.description: Creates a result object indicating successful text replacement.

methods.name: shouldAddMismatchHint
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a mismatch that warrants a hint.

methods.name: appendMismatchHint
methods.description: Enhances an error with current file content snippet for debugging.
